title: RetroBIOS rom folders of one setup
description: What a frontend's own source says about its game folders, read at pinned revisions (platforms/romfolders/<setup>.yml, written by python -m scripts.scraper.romfolders). Names are the OS's own: scripts/romfolders.py resolves them to repository systems and profiles.

ref.description: '<source key> <path>:<line>[-<line>]', several joined by '; '. The key names an entry of sources.

platform.description: The install manifest (install/<platform>.json) the installer uses on this setup, as install.py's OS rules choose it. Empty for a setup the installer lays out with no manifest.

path.description: Null for a setup with no rom folder of its own.

from_bios.description: The roms root relative to the BIOS folder the installer already knows. Null when no fixed relation exists.

case_sensitive.description: Whether the OS opens a folder only under the spelling it lists. Null when the source does not settle it (filesystem dependent).

skip.description: Folders under the roms root the scan never enters (the ELEC family's bios folder, the OS's own data).

hidden.description: File and folder name patterns (fnmatch, case-insensitive) the OS hides from its game list.

media.description: Folders inside a system folder that hold artwork, never games.

folder.description: Path under the roms root, as the OS writes it.

name.description: The OS's own system id when it differs from the folder.

extensions.description: Lowercased, with the dot. Absent when the OS lists every file.

files.description: Whole file names the OS lists as games, as it writes them, in place of or beside extensions.

core.description: The core or emulator the OS starts by default, in its own spelling.

searched_by.description: The standalone emulators whose commands for this folder pass a ROM search path, and the folders below the roms root it names.

machines.description: The machines the commands start, as the emulator names them.

any_machine.description: A command starts the game itself as the machine (ES-DE's %BASENAME%).
